meta.name: azure-architecture-autopilot
meta.description:
Design Azure infrastructure using natural language, or analyze existing Azure resources to auto-generate architecture diagrams, refine them through conversation, and deploy with Bicep.
When to use this skill: - "Create X on Azure", "Set up a RAG architecture" (new design) - "Analyze my current Azure infrastructure", "Draw a diagram for rg-xxx" (existing analysis) - "Foundry is slow", "I want to reduce costs", "Strengthen security" (natural language modification) - Azure resource deployment, Bicep template generation, IaC code generation - Microsoft Foundry, AI Search, OpenAI, Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Databricks, and all Azure services

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言设计并部署 Azure 架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需在 Azure 上设计或优化基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Design and deploy Azure architecture using natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often design or optimize infrastructure on Azure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据自然语言指令设计 Azure 架构并生成交互式架构图，或分析现有 Azure 资源自动出图，随后通过对话优化并生成 Bicep 代码进行部署。
howto.when: 当你提出新设计请求（如“创建X在Azure上”）、现有分析请求（如“分析当前基础设施”）或自然语言修改（如“速度慢”、“降成本”）时触发。

say.text: 在Azure上创建一个带AI搜索的RAG架构
say.note: 启动新设计流程，生成架构图。

say.text: 分析我的Azure资源，画出rg-prod的图
say.note: 扫描现有资源并生成架构图。

say.text: 我的Foundry应用慢，帮我优化架构
say.note: 分析现有资源并给出修改建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design Azure infrastructure from natural language and generate interactive architecture diagrams, or analyze existing Azure resources to auto-generate diagrams, then refine through conversation and deploy with Bicep.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for new designs (e.g., "Create X on Azure"), existing analysis (e.g., "Analyze my current infrastructure"), or natural language modifications (e.g., "slow", "reduce costs").

say_en.text: Create a RAG architecture with AI Search on Azure
say_en.note: Starts new design flow, generates diagram.

say_en.text: Analyze my Azure resources and draw a diagram for rg-prod
say_en.note: Scans existing resources and generates diagram.

say_en.text: My Foundry app is slow, help me optimize the architecture
say_en.note: Analyzes existing resources and suggests modifications.
